# Alpaion Analytics

> Alpaion is a consultancy for data analytics, artificial intelligence, process optimisation and automation, research, strategy development and go-to-market. Vendor-neutral, hands-on, serving the DACH region in German and English.

## Services
- Data Analytics & Business Intelligence: We build a consistent, reliable data foundation and make the relevant performance drivers transparent, so that management and business units decide on the basis of the same numbers.
- Artificial Intelligence: We identify the AI use cases with the highest value, assess them for benefit, feasibility and risk, and take them from prototype into production.
- Operational Excellence: We make processes transparent end to end, quantify inefficiencies and design target processes that sustainably reduce lead times, costs and error rates.
- Process Automation: We automate repetitive tasks and integrate systems seamlessly. This frees capacity for value-adding work and increases speed, quality and scalability.
- Research & Analysis: We deliver fact-based decision support: researched systematically, backed by sources and structured to accelerate decisions.
- Strategy Development: We develop strategies that prioritise, quantify and can be executed: for data and AI, for digital transformation and for the core business.
- Go-to-Market Advisory: We sharpen positioning, offering and pricing, and align marketing and sales with the customer segments that hold the greatest potential.
- AI Governance & EU AI Act: We establish the framework for responsible and compliant use of AI: with clear policies, robust risk assessment and targeted capability building.

## Engagement formats
- Strategic sparring (by the hour or day): Second opinion on investment and technology decisions, preparation of board and investor meetings
- Diagnostics & workshops (1 to 10 days): AI potential analysis, data maturity assessment, process diagnostics, strategy retreat
- Projects (4 to 16 weeks, fixed price available): Reporting and analytics solutions, AI applications, automation, market studies, go-to-market planning
- Interim & fractional (from one day per week): Interim head of data & AI, chief data officer, go-to-market lead or programme lead
- Managed services (ongoing): Further development, operation and monitoring of live solutions
- Enablement & training (half-day to multi-day): AI literacy under Art. 4 AI Act, analytics, automation, executive formats

## Approach
1. Diagnostic (1–2 weeks): We analyse objectives, data, processes and market context and conduct interviews with the relevant stakeholders. Result: baseline and target picture
2. Prioritisation (1–2 weeks): We assess levers by value, effort, risk and feasibility and quantify the business case. Result: prioritised roadmap
3. Implementation (4–12 weeks): We deliver the prioritised initiatives iteratively, validate them in live operations and optimise against defined KPIs. Result: live solution with measurable impact
4. Embedding (ongoing): We ensure a structured handover, enable your teams and support operations and scaling. Result: sustained value
